name: Cavitot
look: a single cream molar with a rotten black cavity in its top, pale pink diamond eyes, blush and a jagged frown, standing on two stubby roots
entry: It started out as a baby tooth that was never brushed. The cavity in its crown aches all the time, which is why it always looks so grumpy. It can't resist sweets, even though they make the ache worse.
how: Wild: common near sugar cane (sugar rots teeth) and in Dripstone Caves, uncommon underground and in villages at night.
